sources.entry: iStat Menus - Advanced system monitor for menubar.

summary.name: iStat Menus
summary.one_liner: iStat Menus is a macOS menu bar system monitor that tracks CPU, GPU, memory, disks, network, sensors, battery, weather and more.
use_cases: Monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage from the menu bar
Track per-app network bandwidth on a Mac
Check Mac temperatures, fan speeds, and voltages
View detailed weather forecasts in the menu bar
Get alerts when CPU, disk, or connection state crosses a threshold
Check battery levels of Bluetooth accessories
summary.what_it_does: iStat Menus shows system statistics in the macOS menu bar and in expandable menus. It covers CPU (per-core usage, history, load averages, top apps), GPU, memory (pressure, compressed memory, swap), disks (space, activity, S.M.A.R.T. status), network (bandwidth, connections, IP addresses), battery and power, and sensors including temperatures, fans and voltages. It also includes weather with hourly and weekly forecasts, world clocks with sun and moon info, and a Rules feature that sends notifications based on system events. Items can be combined into a single menu bar item and are highly customisable.
notable: Combined mode merges multiple stats into one menu bar item to save space
Fan speeds can be controlled based on temperature and battery state
Also available through the Setapp subscription
Privacy focused with no ads or analytics, per the vendor
caveats: Offers a 14-day free trial; purchase needed after that
Upgrade pricing requires an iStat Menus 6 license; exact prices are not shown on the page
